part.text:
Fixed `Blueprint::foreignIdFor()` so integer-keyed models use an unsigned bigint column regardless of whether the key auto-increments. Previously, a non-incrementing int key fell through to the UUID branch, producing `char(36)`.

Validation: `tests/Database/DatabaseSchemaBlueprintTest.php` passes all 33 tests.
